name: smart-parking-canvas
description: Compact parking availability canvas for HDB car parks near your destination.

actions.name: setDestination
actions.description: Change the selected destination shown in the canvas.

destination.description: Name of the Singapore destination to look up car parks for.

actions.name: setFilter
actions.description: Apply a vehicle-type or availability filter to the car park list.

filter.description: Filter to apply: all, available, cars, motorcycles, or heavy.
